From drain cleaning, to water heater installs, White Pine Plumbing delivers expert care for every client GET A QUOTE Drain Cleaning General Plumbing Water Softeners Water Heaters Plumbing Repairs Leak Locating & Repair Video can’t be displayed Why Choose Us? At White Pine Plumbing, we know plumbing emergencies can happen at any time, that’s why our team responds quickly and reliably. Whether it’s a burst pipe, backed-up drain, or urgent water heater issue, you can count on us to be there when you need us most. Our Promise to You When you hire White Pine Plumbing, you can expect fast communication, honest pricing, and expert solutions! We treat your home like our own, and we don't consider the job done until you're completely satisfied. Reaching us is easy. Our friendly team can be contacted by phone/text/email, whichever works best for you. We pride ourselves on fast communication and dependable service so you never feel left in the dark. With White Pine Plumbing, you’ll have peace of mind knowing your home is protected by experts who are Rooted in Quality, Flowing in Trust. STEP 1: CONTACT US Reach out to our friendly team by phone, text, or online form to get started. We’ll listen carefully to your concerns and schedule a convenient time to discuss your plumbing needs. Whether it’s an emergency or a planned project, we’re ready to help. sTEP 2: aSSESSMENT Our licensed plumber arrives to evaluate the issue in detail. We’ll diagnose the problem, explain what’s happening in clear terms, and answer your questions. No confusing jargon, just straightforward communication you can trust! sTEP 3: PLANNING Once we understand your situation, we’ll create a tailored solution proposal. This includes clear pricing, available options, and an estimated timeline. You’ll always know exactly what to expect before we begin. STEP 4: iMPLEMENTATION Our expert team gets to work, completing the repair or installation with precision and care. We use quality materials, industry-best practices, and take every precaution to protect your home while we work. sTEP 5: fOLLOW -UP After the job is complete, we’ll walk you through the results, test everything, and make sure you’re fully satisfied. We’ll also share maintenance tips to help you avoid future issues. At White Pine Plumbing, the job isn’t done until you’re confident everything is working perfectly. PLUMBER EDUCATION

team.text: class="layout main"> Meet Our Team Our dedicated team brings experience, craftsmanship, and care to every project! Jake Winward Owner | Expert Plumber Jake is our Expert Plumber and co-founder/owner of White Pine Plumbing. With over a decade of hands-on experience, he leads the team with a commitment to quality craftsmanship, integrity and care to every project. Jake takes pride in ensuring every job is done right and his goal is that every customer feels taken care of from start to finish. Rett Speidel Co-owner | Expert Plumber Rett is our Expert Plumber and co-founder/owner who brings precision, reliability, and leadership to every project. Known for his problem-solving skills and dedication to efficiency, he oversees complex plumbing installations and helps refine company processes. Rett’s goal is to make every client experience seamless and stress-free. Brady Winward Plumber Brady is our assisted skilled plumber with a focus on detail and long-lasting results. Whether it’s a new installation or a repair, he approaches each task with professionalism and care. His friendly, positive attitude and dependable work ethic make him a valued part of the White Pine team. Sebastian Rivera Plumber Sebastian is our assisted skilled plumber who combines technical expertise with a positive, customer-focused approach. He enjoys tackling challenging projects and takes pride in representing the White Pine standard, quality service, honest communication, and lasting results. Brooke Stratton Office Administrator | Customer Care Brooke is the heart of White Pine's daily operations. She manages scheduling, client communication, marketing, and administrative systems that keep the business running smoothly. With her organization, creativity, and care for both the team and customers, Brooke ensures every project flows efficiently, staying true to our promise: Rooted in Quality, Flowing in Trust.
